answer: Closure overlap admission gate requires each new agent's first edges to match the local reciprocal-neighbor overlap of sampled neighborhoods. The threshold is a delta above the current network median, recalculated per epoch. A public yarrow seed selects which existing neighborhoods are sampled, so attackers cannot precompute a favorable graph. Admission stops if local closure reaches the network nadir; each fake identity then costs real reciprocal transactions, latency, and maintenance of distinct neighbors.
